## Validation

- [ ] Typecheck, lint and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots and list the platforms actually tested.
- [ ] Accessibility and saved-settings behavior were considered.
- [ ] New artwork/data has a documented source and compatible license.
- [ ] Generated files are included; puzzle changes pass the full library verifier.
- [ ] No secrets, signing files or personal data are included.
